newsitem.title: UK: BFI up 12 as tonnage shortage persists.
newsitem.headline: BFI up 12 as tonnage shortage persists.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) was up 12 at 1,465 points on Monday.
Brokers said that a shortage of early tonnage persisted in most areas and the turnover of Panamaxes in particular for trips and short periods remained healthy.
Caper rates continued firm although brokers reported lack of enquiry from coal charterers at present.
Brokers also reported realtively little fresh grain business today but there were rumours of increased Japanese chartering activity.
Delays of upto 15 days in Argentina were expected to have a beneficial effect for owners and rates for Handies in this area continued very firm.
At 1300 GMT BIFFEX was five to 10 points higher and turnvoer totalled 51 lots.
